trace_comparison.scope: One diagnostic run per source; first256 callback phase events, complete worker cache-open census; strace overhead, no causal wall-time claim

decisions: Reject bounded hot stencil cache: removed repeated cache read opens but did not retain every prior original-case pass.
Reject128MiB function disk cache: isolated strict-class success did not survive full staging7 retention.
Keep serial compilation: native-parallel3 class trial returned two crashes.
Preserve512-entry/2GiB module memory policy,64MiB disk tiers and original deadlines.
next_measurement: Attribute time inside native compilation; cache I/O elimination alone did not remove the timeout. Captured92562-byte P has26 definitions, of which15 are unreachable (mostly3-byte trap slots); function-cache get counts do not directly equal P function counts.
